verdict.rationale: Babylon.js's Playground provides an interactive code editor where script changes render almost instantly, supporting a fast edit-run loop for quick prototyping. However, there's no documentation of hot module reloading (HMR) for standard npm/webpack-based project workflows, so the loop is only fast within the Playground sandbox, not necessarily in a full game dev pipeline. Missing for 10: evidence of HMR integration with bundlers (webpack/vite) for real project development, and independent confirmation of iteration speed in production workflows.
